questions.question: How does Psalm 110, a royal psalm, begin?
options: 'Blessed is the man who walks not in wicked counsel'
'The LORD says to my Lord: Sit at my right hand'
'Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD'
'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want'
questions.answer: 'The LORD says to my Lord: Sit at my right hand'

questions.question: What priestly order is the Lord declared to be a priest forever after?
The psalm says the LORD will make the king's enemies a footstool for his feet.
Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your _____.
You are a priest forever after the order of _____.
